css: padding: 24px 16px; max-width: 1100px; margin: 0 auto; .product-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(200px, 1fr)); gap: 16px; } .product-card { border: 1px solid #e0e0e0; border-radius: 4px; padding: 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }

provenance.adaptation_notes: Derived from Flipkart's product grid: kept compact card layout with border-radius:4px + flex column, removed images (voice-first), kept price styling with bold accent color
